_comment: Canonical Chinese renderings for the AV family. Both sides are Chinese, so a substring replace cannot touch ASCII machine parts (@UUID bodies, HTML, the English half of a bilingual name). Canon is the PF2 Chinese wiki, then the AV main pack.
